headline: Executive order lets the US government place sanctions on people and groups abroad involved in the illegal drug trade.
what_it_does: This order allows the federal government to impose sanctions on foreign people and organizations involved in the global illegal drug trade. Sanctions like this usually mean freezing their money and property under US control and limiting their access to the US financial system. No summary was provided, so the details here are based mainly on the title.

who_it_affects.group: Foreign drug traffickers and those who support them
who_it_affects.how: They can be targeted with sanctions that may freeze assets and restrict their business with the United States.
They may be barred from doing business with people or groups named under the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 15, 2021; executive orders generally take effect upon signing.
